entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while I connect you with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I'm calling about a return. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me. I want to return it.
Okay, I understand. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. Let me pull up your order details. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on July 18th. Today is August 2nd, correct?
Yes, so what? I want to return it. It's practically brand new!

I understand. However, according to our return policy, the return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase. I'm sorry, but we're unable to process a full refund since it's now been 15 days.
What?! Ten days? That's ridiculous! I didn't see that anywhere! This thing cost me a fortune, and now you're telling me I'm stuck with it? That's terrible customer service!

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for any inconvenience. Our return policy is outlined on our website and also included in the confirmation email you received after placing your order. While a full refund isn't possible due to the exceeded return window, I can explore some options for you. Unfortunately, a policy exception is not something that is generally granted after this amount of time. Would you be open to a store credit for the purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse? This would allow you to select a different product from VeloFit.
Ugh, a store credit? I guess that's better than nothing. But I really wanted my money back.

I understand. Let me process that store credit for you. One moment, please... Okay, the store credit has been applied to your account, john.doe@email.com. You should receive an email confirmation shortly. You can use it towards any product on our website. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
So, I can use it on anything? Even other VeloBands?
Yes, absolutely. You can use the store credit on anything available on the VeloFit website, including other models of the VeloBand or accessories.
Okay, well, thanks. I appreciate you doing that. I guess it works out okay.
You're welcome! I'm glad we could find a solution that works for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thanks again!
You're very welcome! Have a great day with VeloFit!
